digest.component_or_area: rebar doctor command - mapping config diagnostics
propositions: Doctor must surface internally-invalid mapping config (load-time and resolve-time failures) as error findings with details carrying the key and MappingConfigError message verbatim
Doctor must support portable offline-always checks (stdlib-only, no jira-datacenter import) that run when credentials are absent or the optional extra is not installed

Doctor must degrade gracefully to an unavailable finding when live-drift checking is blocked by missing extra, empty JIRA_PAT, ConfigError from settings, or timeout, returning success exit instead of raising

Doctor must detect live-drift divergences between configured and observed vocabulary (status, type, link) via the S8 probe reader, emitting per-axis findings for absent values, while excluding hierarchy as undetectable in Data Center
Doctor must surface all-empty projects blocks as warnings (not errors) and implement doctor-side bounded wall-clock timeout for probe transport to prevent hanging
Mapping findings must go in their own list separate from scan-dirty/lock reports and be kept out of run_repair iteration to preserve blocking-edge finding contract
